variants.prompt: Freya playfully skips through a vibrant, sun-drenched Oslo park during golden hour, her long, auburn hair fluttering in the breeze as she holds a bouquet of wildflowers. Clad in a flowy, bohemian dress with floral patterns, she looks carefree and joyful, her bright smile capturing the warm light of the setting sun. A DSLR camera captures her exuberance from a slight distance, the background a soft focus of lush greenery and colorful blooms, emphasizing her radiant figure and carefree spirit.
